{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: Show all critical tickets that are still unresolved.", "sql": "SELECT t.ticket_id, c.company_name, t.created_at, t.category, t.status, t.subject
FROM support_tickets t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.priority = 'critical' AND t.resolved_at IS NULL
ORDER BY t.created_at"}
